metadata.comparison_tolerance: Wavelength/flux/IVAR rtol=6e-6, atol=5e-6; MASK must be identical. ASCII flux/IVAR is rounded compared with binary FITS.
metadata.identity_basis: Exact WDJname linked by Swan catalogue to Gaia ID; registered NIGHT/EXPID/FIBER match the published exposure inventory.
cautions: Swan's published ASCII rows have rounded flux and IVAR. They are derived from DESI, not a second instrument or an independent spectrum.
This selected first-night archive includes the original masks, replacing the unverified MWDD flag in the shape comparison only.
The existing MWDD colour result is kept as a frozen reference; selecting original per-camera masks can change its shape slightly.
Flux uncertainty is provided by the archive authors from IVAR; the comparison calculation uses IVAR directly.

metadata.archive_product: DESI DR1 iron calibrated exposure cframe
cautions: This is a new observing night for the repository but uses the same DESI instrument.
The full-camera source files are not duplicated in git; retrieve their recorded URLs and verify hashes to re-extract.
Resolution matrices are included as instrumental line-spread information, not a pixel covariance matrix.
Flux is F_lambda in units of 1e-17 erg s^-1 cm^-2 Angstrom^-1; common scale cancels from chromaticity.

limits: The core SDSS Gaia association remains a legacy positional association; the two FITS target the same PLUG coordinates. Separate exposure-epoch Gaia point-estimate checks are documented in sdss_context.json and do not replace the core identity pipeline.
Two headline targets J0429-0354 and J0913+4434 have only one exposure each in the frozen candidate inventory. These other objects do not measure their repeatability.
No survey-wide random or complete repeated-observation sample is constructed.
